note: Lab correction: there is no lab. OpenEvolve is an independent open-source project by Asankhaya Sharma (GitHub: codelion), so 'unknown' in the brief should read 'independent (codelion)'. PyPI (opened) lists 0.0.1 as the earliest release shown, dated Jun 19, 2025; that is the earliest package release visible on that page, not the first public code, so I did not use it. PyPI gives the license as Apache-2.0. The blog post does not state a license.
